name: Stavsnäs to Runmarö runt
description: Stockholm Kayak Trail stage 3 from Stavsnäs around Runmarö, with optional extensions toward Bullerö or Sandhamn.

waypoints.name: Runmarö
waypoints.notes: Services include grocery, restaurant, bakery, cafés and guest harbour according to agent findings.

publicTransport: Bus or car from Stockholm to Stavsnäs
ferry: Runmarö also reachable by ferry from Stavsnäs/Sandhamn.
launchNotes: Stavsnäs has WC, shower, sauna and ICA nearby.

safety.exposure: Medium difficulty; outer-archipelago options and wind-sensitive east side.
windWeatherNotes: Route can be adapted in challenging weather.
seasonalNotes: Dogs on leash March-September; no fires on rocks noted in source findings.

campingRules: Use allemansrätten carefully, avoid private zones, and apply national-park rules if extending into Nämdöskärgården.

protectionRules.summary: Runmarö/Stavsnäs route is mixed settled/protected archipelago; use legal landings and verify local reserve rules for Skarp-Runmar/Vånsholmen-style side trips.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Use official guest harbours/campsites where available.
Small reserves can prohibit fires and limit camping to 24 h or designated arrangements.
